new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&s&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&p.kind==='PICK_TARGET'&&/starting player/i.test(p.messageText||'')){g.answer({uuid:g.hello.myPlayerId})}else if(p&&s&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&(p.kind==='ASK'&&p.mulligan)){clearInterval(t);r('Mulligan-Frage')}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r("Timeout Mulligan")},240000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const s=window.__ml.game.getState().state;const me=s&&s.players.find(x=>x.me);const c=me&&me.command.find(o=>o.kind==='companion');if(c){clearInterval(t);r('Gefaehrte in der Kommandozone: '+c.name)}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout Gefaehrte')},30000)})
